steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each breakdown is placed by when it happened in the week.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 asset broke down more than three times

findings.title: Asset with more than three breakdowns in the week
findings.fix: Stop and review the asset's condition

findings.title: Duration does not match start and end

outcome.notChecked: Causes that need a physical check.

example:

pros: Checks a breakdown with no cause code, a duration that does not match its start and end, and an asset with more than three breakdowns in the week.
cons: Not checked: Causes that need a physical check.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-breakdown-review skill on the records for this review.
